slides.texte_overlay:
7 social hacks that feel like
cheating on a group trip
Create the group chat with one simple rule: decisions get made by vote within an hour. No endless debates about restaurants, and everyone feels heard.
Bring a small speaker and a shared playlist. Ask everyone to add five songs before the trip. Car rides become a party instead of a long silent drive.
Learn three words in the local language. Hello, thank you, cheers. You'll become the group's translator, and locals will treat you all a little better.
Pack a few extras for others. Plasters, a phone charger, painkillers, snacks. Being the guy who always has what someone needs makes you everyone's favourite.
Bring the stories. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I'm always the one who knows why a castle or a church in town is famous.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I always know why the castle or church in town is famous.

slides.texte_overlay: Plan one surprise for the group. A sunset spot, a hidden bar, a local festival. One unexpected moment becomes the highlight everyone talks about for years.
Check on the quiet one. Trips can be tiring and loud. A simple "You good? Want to grab a coffee?" can make someone's whole trip so much better.
